text:
maya.partnerships: Heads-up — Intel reached out with an early preview offer for their new Hopper-derivative boards. They want a small EAP (preview) run to validate latency and cost curves before broader marketplace listing. NDA attached: https://intel.example/ndas/hopper-preview.pdf
liam.bench: nice. do we have a target testbed? single-node or multi-node?
maya.partnerships: initial ask is single-node across two SKUs (A100-ish perf and a denser Hopper variant). Carlos from Intel will confirm exact boards. goal: perf profile + failure modes + recommended kv-cache settings.
carlos_intel: correct — we'll provide two board samples and a firmware image. timing: samples ship next week, we expect ~3 week window for initial benchmarks. we can also provide power telemetry if you want.
liam.bench: please yes for power telemetry. test plan suggestion: 1) 1k seq synthetic + real prompt traces (from prod sanitized) 2) steady-state throughput (tokens/sec) 3) cold vs warm KV cache p50/p99 4) memory & power under max batch.
anya.eng-ml: for model variants, we should include our standard q4 and q8 quantized builds + float16 baseline. include a small eval set to check hallucination/regression (prompt-set: redwood/hopper-preview-pset).
sophia.legal: NDA looks mostly fine but we need two edits: 1) carve out internal benchmark telemetry for Redwood ops (we need right to store/aggregate metrics), 2) clarify embargo period for any co-marketing materials. I'll mark up and send back today.
maya.partnerships: thanks sophia. action items: sophia -> edit NDA; liam -> draft bench matrix + runbook; anya -> pick eval prompts; nate -> verify runtime build compatibility + any kernel flags. Carlos -> confirm exact part numbers and when samples land.
nate.eng-runtime: confirmed we'll need a build with 'hopper-compat' kernel selector. also flagging that we might want to disable some autotune passes for stability: CONFIG_AUTOTUNE=0 in runtime config.
liam.bench: drafting runbook now — plan to run the harness under /bench/hopper-preview with command: `./run_bench.sh --config configs/hopper_eap.yaml --samples 3` and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-eap/intel-hopper/17685. will include scripts to ingest power telemetry.
carlos_intel: FYI shipping ETA: labels created, courier pickup Wed. Also we'll add a small firmware patch; please run validation test `fw_check.sh` before benchmarks.
maya.partnerships: timeline check: NDA signoffs by EOD Thursday, samples arrive next Wed, bench window Wed-Fri next week, internal review following Monday. then we sync with Intel on go/no-go for marketplace preview page.
sophia.legal: NDA edits sent — see inline comments. main concern is marketing embargo — propose 30 days after Redwood publishes internal report.
anya.eng-ml: uploaded eval set and expected metrics sheet to drive link: https://drive.redwood/hopper-eap/eval (access: partnerships-only).
nate.eng-runtime: provisioning container images now; will post sha once done. expected 4 hours.
liam.bench: quick Q on metrics: do we want p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, memory, watts, and model quality delta?
maya.partnerships: yes to all. include confidence intervals and raw traces for p99 spikes.
carlos_intel: happy with that list. we can also stream NVLink counters if you want deeper traces.
maya.partnerships: great. final note — let's keep comms in this thread for EAP logistics. I'll set a short async checkpoint on Friday to capture early numbers. :thumbsup:
